_comment: Agent-bus managed-session allowlist TEMPLATE. Tokens __CONTROL_PLANE_DIR__ (the rocky-sessions script dir), __DATA_DIR__ (where sessions.md and the other registries live; the same as the script dir unless data-dir moved them), __STATE_DIR__ (~/.rocky-sessions), and __BUS_DIR__ (the _agent-bus queue) are substituted for your machine by `rocky-sessions gen-session-settings <dir>`, which writes a filled <dir>/.claude/settings.json. The deny-list is defense-in-depth (spec 9b): it blocks the Write/Edit TOOLS on the control plane, credentials, and persistence surfaces. IMPORTANT: a permission list cannot stop a shell redirect (cat x > file) or find -exec; the DURABLE control-plane protection is filesystem-level (make Rocky Scripts/ + scheduled-tasks.md read-only to the account sessions run as). Tailor allow/deny per session; prefer the narrowest allow-list you can. Install BEFORE flipping a session's profile to 'auto'.
